src.rate_limited: {what} is rate limiting requests or today's quota is used up. Try again later.
src.captcha_title: OpenReview is asking for a human check, so the title can't be looked up right now
src.captcha_search: OpenReview is asking for a human check, so it can't be searched right now
src.acl_not_paper: This ACL Anthology entry is a proceedings volume, not a paper
capture.not_found: Couldn't find {ident} in {source}. Is the link or id mistyped?
capture.title_missing: {error}. Added to the inbox by id; the title couldn't be fetched.
api.scholar_window: The Google Scholar window opens only in the desktop app
run.no_python: Can't find a Python to run the tracker (the project's .venv or python3 on PATH)
run.not_configured: research_tracker isn't set up (the tracker entry in studio.toml)
run.busy_running: A run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
run.busy_lock: Another run is still going (maybe one started before a restart). Wait for it to finish.
run.busy_proc: A tracker is already running (maybe the weekly scheduled run). Wait for it to finish.
